reviews.author: rrichards31
reviews.text: I brought my 1984 Toyota pickup to Foothills Imports in Anderson, SC for timing chain work. The vehicle was in their possession for a little over six months. While the timing chain replacement appears to have been completed, I experienced multiple issues afterward that required me to redo a significant amount of the work myself. In total, I spent over $6,000 with this shop. After getting the vehicle back, it ran poorly and inconsistently. I brought it back two to three times for the same issues before being advised to replace the carburetor. I later discovered that the distributor had not been set correctly from the start, which affected engine timing and overall performance and was a major cause of the drivability problems. I was initially charged to have my original carburetor rebuilt. After continued issues, I was then told it would be better to replace it. I paid for a replacement carburetor that turned out to be a low-quality aftermarket unit, and I was not refunded for the original rebuild. My original carburetor was also not returned to me. In addition, the carburetor and intake were improperly sealed with excessive silicone and damaged gaskets, causing vacuum leaks, fuel leakage, unstable idle, and poor drivability. Once I corrected these issues myself using proper parts and installation, the truck ran correctly. Based on my experience, I would not recommend this shop. I paid for what I expected to be quality workmanship and was patient throughout a lengthy repair process, and I should not have had to redo the work myself to get the vehicle running properly.

reviews.author: Carla Moss
reviews.text: They have worked on my Merceedes,BMW and Ford ,very reasonable ,love the customer service on each visit!I saved a few thousand dollars overall on each vehicle,each vehicle is still operating in good condition!

reviews.author: Mike Trotter
reviews.text: I have been using Foothills for many years and have always been treated very well. Their staff is friendly and knowledgeable. Always takes care of my vehicles the first time at the best price. Their technicians are knowledgeable, nice and take great care of your needs. Wouldn't consider any other place. Satisfaction guaranteed.

reviews.author: Dwayne Rainey
reviews.text: DO NOT TAKE YOUR CAR HERE! You are much better off taking your car to the dealership for service. I took my car in for what appeared to be a worn out shock but it was driving fantastic otherwise. When I picked it up the car was sitting on the wheels and they tried to tell me it came in that way. Gave me a list of over $6000 in repairs and not one of them was an actual repair needed. Had to have it towed to the Volvo dealership and they fixed the damage they created, properly diagnosed the vehicle and saved me thousands. This place is criminal!

reviews.author: John Danials
reviews.text: I was a loyal customer definitely see the bigger picture now. Oil leaks that needed to be fixed I question just because over the phone we had talked about the most serious oil leaks and I paid close to 10,000 for it to be done just so I can still have a oil leak. I started thinking hard about it and it came when I got a oil change and was charged 300-350 closer to the 350 range and I’m like that’s the highest I’ve ever paid for a oil change???!? Then I get a quote to get my front brakes and rotors changed and said it was gonna be $1400?? Good think one of my boys knew a guy and I saved $700. Said they was only charging I think 120 to put them on and I mean where are u getting the parts from? Are they made to last forever?? That’s the only good part of the story is basically I saved $700 from not going to them. Oh yea also when I got the car power steering was great didn’t have no problems with it till I left foothills. SMH now I have to pay someone for that as well. U go there if u want too I spent a lot of money and regret it and u will too. I think they have the ones they keep and the ones they might take advantage from. I liked them as far as in people but it’s like the whole time tryna get over on me. Anyways “Frees” automotive I had got a estimate regardless just to see for next time and see how much foothills charged me over or was it going to be the same or cheaper before I went and wrote a review. They was gonna charge me $900. $500 more than Frees that seems like they was tryna take advantage

reviews.author: Michelle Rice
reviews.text: I took my car over to their place for a smoke test, a few weeks ago. They were knowledgeable of the need for my car. They ran a diagnostic test. The lady that works there, knows her stuff! I appreciate the honesty, kindness and professionalism!

reviews.author: Dom Crotty
reviews.text: I've been taking my old cars here for five years and always had good service, honest estimates and quality work performed. This establishment is recomended. Thanks, Foothills Import Automotive!

reviews.author: Brittney “Brittn” Murray
reviews.text: Oh, where do I even begin with this "stellar" experience? If you're looking to throw away $1350 on a job that's nowhere near completed, then look no further! This mechanic's service is a masterclass in how not to fix a car. First, they charged me a cool $1350 for what they claimed was a thorough job. Surprise, surprise, it wasn’t. When I pointed out that my car was still not fixed, they suddenly remembered it was only the "first phase" of the process. Silly me, thinking that "fixing" meant the job would be done. Then, the plot thickens. They had the audacity to tell me it would be another $1300 to actually complete the repair. Of course, this was only after changing their story from "we didn't know the compressor was messed up until we looked" to "this was only a first phase of the fixing process." Consistency and honesty clearly isn’t their strong suit. In summary, if you enjoy inconsistent stories, incomplete work, and an empty wallet, then this is the place for you. Otherwise, steer clear unless you want to become the proud owner of a car with an unnecessary repair and a wealth of frustration.

reviews.author: Vladislav Balabanov
reviews.text: Brought the car in for an alignment. Car pulls to right side when let go off the wheel and goes to the left if put steering wheel dead center - so steering wheel was not put dead center. Brought back to fix the issue and got charged another $38 claiming my steering rack is at fault and this is a fee to put the car up.on the rack. Don't stand behind their work. Don't recommend.

reviews.author: Carol Smith
reviews.text: Please don't go here!! My car was misdiagnosed. They over priced a starter possible problem on my car for over $200+. I went to the dealership and it was $200+ less than they said if it was the starter, which did not end up being that, just a battery. They thought I was going to agree to pay $800 for a starter and a new battery. I went to the dealership and just needed a battery and he said there is no such thing as diagnostic for a starter. They were trying to get over! I think it was because we had extended warranty, and they wanted to get over with them. The warranty company did not agree to pay that, because I think they knew it was something fishy, but they had to go along with the lie anyway, so they dumped the remainder of what they thought the warranty company was going to pay on us thinking that we were going to go along with it and not notice that this quote was not right. When I went to pick up the car, I told them that I was being overcharged and the lady just said we can run some different numbers to see if we could get it cheaper. I told her no, and that if you could not try to do it right the first time, why would I trust you to it the second time. The owner just looked at us funny when we came to pick the car back up, because he knew he was trying to rip us off. Always get a second opinion, because if they think you are nice or don't know, they will get over. My car was a 2019 year. They know they was getting over. I only had to pay $119 for a 5 year battery at the dealership. They was going to charge $129 plus $50+ just for battery installation alone. The dealership did not charge anything and they did a free first time checkpoint. They charged us about $40 bucks for nothing they did.

reviews.author: Ron Click
reviews.text: Aircon evaporator replaced in my 2016 MX-5. Work done in a timely manner at a fair price. Foothills provided courtesy rides from the shop after leaving the car with them and also picked me up when the work was completed. Note that if you are not reasonably close to the shop, I doubt they would supply such a service, which is fair.

reviews.author: Jennifer Stover
reviews.text: I’m an out of town girl with a broken down car. Such an easy mark for an auto shop. Not Foothills. These gentlemen were honest, kind and fast! I expected the repairs to take a few days but was pleasantly surprised when they called me the very afternoon that my car had been taken in. The price was extremely fair and the work was top-notch.

reviews.author: Josh Thomas
reviews.text: Don't listen to hot headed one star reviews from one-time "customers" who ask for the world in exchange for pennies and have unattainable and unreasonable demands. I have a long standing relationship with Foothills Import and the only regrets I have are those related to my brief times of patronage at other shops. I have had four of my own vehicles of both imported and domestic brands regularly serviced and if necessary extensively repaired here over the course of the last few years in addition to referring others, and the work is always solid. Kim, David, and Roger are all pleasant, friendly, and professional. In addition, the mechanics are knowledgeable and almost always get straight to the issues in a timely fashion. In regards to speed, value, and quality of service, 5 stars are certainly merited. Perhaps the one quality that distinguishes Foothills from many, many others, however, is simply their honesty. If they think you don't need something, they won't sell it to you. If they think someone else has a better deal, they won't hesitate to refer you. Kim and her team understand that honesty truly is the best policy, and I will recommend her business to anyone I can as long as they are in business.

reviews.author: Will Gavin
reviews.text: HONEST. Asked to check brake pads more than once and was told i don't need them. Great job servicing my Lexus; 10 years old, no problems. They may cost more, but you get good honest service. Worth it!

reviews.author: Jamonique Williams
reviews.text: The staff here is welcoming yet professional. I'm in the process of taking care of some much needed repairs to my car. I looked up some repair shops when searching for a good company that would take care of the repairs, and this company had good reviews on Google; just quoted as being a bit pricey by some of the reviewers. This company has been very helpful in aiding me in taking care of my car repairs, as a person who only has one vehicle that is greatly needed to get back and forth to work and school, I am glad to be able to trust my car to them.

reviews.author: Alison Phillips
reviews.text: They were asked to replace a rack and pinion which was in warranty from another shop. I also told the husband that I wanted them to check for power steering leaks, etc since there had been problems with this car. I wanted it fixed right once and for all! I explained all of that him in a long conversation. Well, 400 miles later the rack and pinion had a blown seal at the worm gear effectively ruining a brand new rack. You would think good mechanics would check all this knowing there had been problems! I told them I wanted the power steering checked because it was obviously a problem causing the rack to fail. Sure enough, the power steering return hose was crimped causing problems with pressure and blowing out the seal on the rack and causing a leak in a new power steering pump reservoir. I ended up having to replace the rack AGAIN, replace a new power steering pump and a hose. Doing their due diligence to check a complete problem rather than just putting an expensive part on has caused me a lot more money! I would never recommend them again. They just put a band-aid on my car when it needed a proper repair.

reviews.author: Ryan Keel
reviews.text: Brought in my steering knuckle with a set of new bearings they pressed out the old ones and put it all back together for a very low price and barely any wait time my car is back on the road for the weekend thanks to these people. Outstanding work, professional business's and awesome lady working the front all-around 5 star atmosphere. Thank you foothills

reviews.author: Levi Crowder
reviews.text: They diagnosed the check engine light on my fiat and had it ready to go in 48 hours even though they had to wait for parts to come in. The price was totally reasonable. The staff was very friendly. I’ll be coming back as needed!

reviews.author: Carolyn Scruggs
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about these people! I live in Atlanta but had to take my mother's 2001 Lexus suv to them for repair. They went over and beyond what they needed to do at no additional charge. They are honest, do excellent work, (I thought very reasonably priced) and people of intrigrity. Yes! I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Hassen Oros
reviews.text: They are a reliable and honest shop. I’m overseas and my car that’s in storage needed work. They coordinated the towing to and from, provided the estimate, and issued repairs all in a timely manner. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Chris A.
reviews.text: I went to Foothills for an alignment on my truck. When I dropped it off I provided specific specs for it to be aligned to. When I came back to pick it up they provided a sheet showing the after specs and the mechanic was able to set it up perfectly. Very impressed with the level of detail taken to meet my request. Much better than another shop up the road which was unable to align it correctly.

reviews.author: Chad Powell
reviews.text: I’ve taken my BMW there twice now. Once for a starter and now for a battery. The work has been quick, easy, and priced right. Think twice before taking yours to the dealership.

reviews.author: April Jones
reviews.text: This was my first time going to foothills, I wanted my oil changed and to get my car serviced to.see if anything was going on with it they did a good job but it costed way more than I expected but I'm happy with the results. I was waiting in.their waiting room for some time I think they need to upgrade that the chairs had dog hair all over it and there was no dog. One had a bad stain on it. I wish I'm could have dropped my car and come back for it but I just have the one car. I will be going back to foothills for my next oil change

reviews.author: ryan Cohen
reviews.text: I sent my car in for an alignment when I got it back the car pulled harder to the left with new tires. About 2 days later the steering angle sensor light poped on. Then they wanted to charge me again to look into the problem. Took the car to another shop and they where able to reset the light with no issues and have not had any issue for 3 weeks now. When I showed the paper work to another shop the specs they went by where for a base model with a non sport suspension witch changed the numbers

reviews.author: Jaime Geddie
reviews.text: Foothills has gone above and beyond both times I’ve brought my Kia in to them. They have worked me in both visits and made sure they took very good care of me and made sure my car was ok for travel. I wouldn’t take my car to anyone else when it comes to mechanical issues

reviews.author: Adam Oster
reviews.text: Had a car break down on the road and found this place as the nearest towing option available for our Toyota. Very friendly, looked at it right away in the morning. Ultimately they were too expensive and we took the car elsewhere, but the experience was pleasant.

reviews.author: Crystal Shirley
reviews.text: Recently took my 2010 Vw Jetta to Foothills. Of course being a German import I was expecting the worse outcome. Expecting to spend thousands of dollars bc the motor was moving way to freely. I took my jetta on Friday afternoon and got a call the following Monday am first thing. The repairs were no more than 120$ my car drives even better than before. Honest great people, that definitely know what they are doing. I now know I have great mechanic shop to take my car to. I would recommend Foothills to anyone with an import. Great service and friendly staff. Thank you again for the great service. :)

reviews.author: Kate King
reviews.text: Honest, reliable and affordable. They provide assessments and recommendations, and are up front whether repair is critical or can wait. They will also tell you if a vehicle isn’t worth fixing. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jon Horton
reviews.text: Having recently moved to anderson, I was hesitant about finding a good mechanic. I slowly started coming here for minor, then major repairs, and have never been disappointed. The staff are always friendly and knowledgeable and the prices are on par with the service. Definitely recommended!

reviews.author: Ernest Mazzella
reviews.text: Brought my car there $40 diagnostic check I wind up waiting over an hour to diagnose the car, they put it on the computer and looked under the hood and could not diagnose problem, I explain to them to take the car for spin to figure out what's wrong with it, mechanic finally did that and he finally realized what the problem was ,instead of going through all his unnecessary steps of computers It was just a loose hose that came out ,, also they told me fuel filter is the original one on the car and I explained to them it wasn't , once again guessing on things not diagnosing things right, they explain to me that's the way there diagnose procedures is . I told them that's fine and left it at that, but owner or the lady manager put her two cent in very rude, lost customer....bc of her

reviews.author: Lori Wynne
reviews.text: These guys are awesome! The ladies in the office are so friendly and just made the experience so much better! Thanks to all at Foothills for getting my car in and out so quickly!

reviews.author: Arianna Roberts
reviews.text: I have been going to foothills for all my car needs, and they have taken care of everything I needed. They are trustworthy, fast, and very reliable.

reviews.author: Tony Adcock
reviews.text: Great service for cars. Been going there for years and very reliable repair service. Highly recommend. They may specialize in certain cars but not real sure. For sure They work on Chevy, and GMC. I would say Toyota and Honda too

reviews.author: Kevin Spendley
reviews.text: brought a piece of junk lexus up there for them to inspect. they warned me not to buy it and it was only 40$ for a full inspection. was only there for about an hour and they are very friendly.

reviews.author: Ron Dotson
reviews.text: Sorry place brother took his car there to be fixed and paid $1997.00. And he went to pick up and didn’t get 2 miles away and car caught on fire. Oh but it wasn’t there fault they say. The owner is very rude and said if you want it fixed it will cost more money!!!!! VERY BAD BUSINESS!!!!!!

reviews.author: Laura Deane
reviews.text: You'll not find a better auto mechanic group in the stats! They are knowledgeable, professional, and provide incredible customer service. Wouldn't take my car anywhere else.

reviews.author: Chirs Bailey
reviews.text: I was very happy with the work foothills important did, I dropped my car when they opened and they fixed my oil leak put on rotors and brakes and cleaned the excess oi. I will be coming back for now on.

reviews.author: Jeff Roberts
reviews.text: I deliver people there all the time. Everyone says they do good work, but they're a little pricey. I'd rather pay a little more and know it's done right.

reviews.author: Gary Dunihue
reviews.text: I had got a used car, and was Told a bunch of lies about the Car I took it to put Put Hill In was told that the car was not worth fixing thank you for your honesty I really appreciate it into the guy that sold me the car I hope somebody does the same thing to you.

reviews.author: Kevin Dubya
reviews.text: I've brought my BMW here several times. Although they are expensive, most European auto mechanics are. They've always fit me in, and diagnosed the problem.

reviews.author: Kendra Zappitella
reviews.text: Very rude. Didnt even fix my alignment at all but still charged me the money like they did. The manager is very unprofessional. Hollering at me on the phone.

reviews.author: Pamela Latimer
reviews.text: They were great. I still have to noise on the driver side front, but I will just take it back to them later.

reviews.author: Tasha Davis
reviews.text: Great Mechanics!! They completed the job in a timely manner. I would recommend Foothills Automotive to all friends and family!

reviews.author: Deborah Gambrell
reviews.text: They are very straight up when it comes to telling you about issues with your car I really appreciated that Thanks Mr Dave.

reviews.author: Vanessa Kinsey
reviews.text: Glad to have a local repair shop for imports. Without having to drive to dealership in Greenville SC and back. For any repairs for our VW

reviews.author: Candi White
reviews.text: Was honest about what needed to be fixed on my BMW....if you have a foreign car this is the place to go!

reviews.author: BimmerE90
reviews.text: If you have a German car please don’t bother taking it there, I just took my BMW for the fifth time to get an oil leak taken care of and they finally fixed it but now I got other things messing up on my car, very frustrating but never going there again.

reviews.author: Tim Morgan
reviews.text: Said they worked on mini coopers then proceeded to tell me they didn't have the tools to work on them. Lord I'm confused, either you can or you cant
